comment: Tools a voice session gets from windows-commander. Profile "screen" (the default) = windows_commander_screen + windows_commander_actions; "screen_only" = windows_commander_screen; "all" = every tool. Read by voice_tools.rs (include_str!) and by scripts/voice-eval. Chosen with the eval; see specs/ScreenPresence_design.md, sections 5 and 11.
